model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates the “effect” values for several language models, including mBERT-L2, XLM-L2, mBERT-R2, XLM-R2, mBERT-B2, and mBERT-B2, across a series of linguistic evaluations. The horizontal axis displays categories representing linguistic evaluations, including IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic family, IE-other, Isolate, and Semitic, listed in alphabetical order. The vertical axis, labeled “effect”, ranges from approximately 0 to 30 and utilizes a linear scale with tick labels spaced approximately every 5 units. Each bar represents a specific language model, with the color corresponding to the model type as indicated in the legend: mBERT-L2 is represented by a magenta bar, XLM-L2 by a teal bar, mBERT-R2 by a dark red bar, XLM-R2 by a brown bar, mBERT-B2 by a navy bar, and mBERT-B2 by a dark gray bar. The bars are accompanied by error bars representing standard deviation. The tallest bar, representing mBERT-L2, has an approximate value of 27, while the shortest bar, representing IE-other, has an approximate value of 3.  The bars are not sorted in any particular order.
